title.en: A plaque for an old building
title.es: Una placa para un edificio antiguo

es: Escribir el texto de una placa informativa con pasivas variadas, un causativo y atribución prudente.

teaching.en: This plaque was placed at the entrance in 2012.
teaching.es: Esta placa se colocó en la entrada en 2012.
teaching.explanationEs: Una placa usa pasivas breves con fecha, sin hablar de quien la puso.
teaching.audioText: This plaque was placed at the entrance in 2012.

teaching.en: It is believed that the clock was brought from Switzerland, but this has never been proved.
teaching.es: Se cree que el reloj fue traído de Suiza, pero nunca se ha probado.
teaching.explanationEs: It is believed that… atribuye con prudencia un dato que no está probado.
segments: It is believed that the clock was brought
from Switzerland, but this has never been proved.
teaching.audioText: It is believed that the clock was brought from Switzerland, but this has never been proved.

teaching.en: The roof was repaired in 2012, and the council had the walls painted by local students.
teaching.es: El techo se reparó en 2012 y el ayuntamiento hizo pintar las paredes a estudiantes locales.
teaching.explanationEs: have + objeto + participio: un servicio que encargas a otros.
segments: The roof was repaired in 2012, and the
council had the walls painted by local students.
teaching.audioText: The roof was repaired in 2012, and the council had the walls painted by local students.

teaching.en: Guided tours are offered every Sunday, and the building is protected by law.
teaching.es: Se ofrecen visitas guiadas todos los domingos y el edificio está protegido por ley.
teaching.explanationEs: Presente pasivo para lo que ocurre hoy: are offered, is protected.
segments: Guided tours are offered every Sunday, and
the building is protected by law.
teaching.audioText: Guided tours are offered every Sunday, and the building is protected by law.

teaching.en: The old clock was brought from abroad and had to be repaired.
teaching.es: El viejo reloj fue traído del extranjero y hubo que repararlo.
teaching.explanationEs: Brought es el participio de bring: was brought = fue traído.
segments: The old clock was brought from
abroad and had to be repaired.
teaching.audioText: The old clock was brought from abroad and had to be repaired.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Esta placa fue colocada en la entrada.»

answer.text: This plaque was placed at the entrance

feedback.es: Sujeto + was + participio + lugar: así se abre una placa informativa.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo presentas un dato que no se puede probar?

choices.text: It is believed that the clock came from Switzerland.
The clock came from Switzerland, definitely.
They believe it the clock came from Switzerland.

feedback.es: It is believed that… atribuye el dato con prudencia; «The clock came…, definitely» lo afirma sin pruebas y «They believe it the clock» está mal construida.

hint.es: Busca la atribución prudente con pasiva impersonal.

prompt.es: Completa: «El ayuntamiento hizo pintar las paredes.»

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio expresa un servicio que se encarga a otros.

prompt.es: Completa las dos frases para la placa.

feedback.es: Are para lo que ocurre habitualmente hoy (plural) y was para un hecho pasado (singular).

origin.text: Traducción: «Se ofrecen visitas todos los domingos por la tarde.» «El techo se reparó en 2012.»

prompt.es: Elige la frase más adecuada para una placa informativa.

choices.text: Workers built the hall in 1890 and other workers restored it in 2010.
The hall was built in 1890 and restored in 2010.
I think somebody built the hall in 1890, maybe.

feedback.es: Una placa usa pasivas breves con fechas y sin opiniones personales ni agentes vagos.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada estructura con su función en la placa.

feedback.es: Cada estructura cumple una función: atribuir, nombrar al autor, encargar un servicio o describir lo habitual.

prompt.es: Escribe el texto de una placa sobre la estación del barrio.

answer.text: The Old Station. The station was built in 1912 and was designed by the architect Mateo Vera. It was badly damaged by a fire in 1965, and it was closed in 1980. It is believed that the clock above the entrance was brought from Switzerland, but this has never been proved. The building was restored by the town council in 2012. The council also had the front wall painted by local students. Today the station is open to visitors every Sunday, and guided tours are offered.
accepted: The Old Station. The station was built in 1912 and was designed by the architect Mateo Vera. It was badly damaged by a fire in 1965, and it was closed in 1980. It is believed that the clock above the entrance was brought from Switzerland, but this has never been proved. The building was restored by the town council in 2012. The council also had the front wall painted by local students. Today the station is open to visitors every Sunday, and guided tours are offered.

The Old Station. The station was built in 1912 and was planned by the architect Mateo Vera. It was seriously damaged by a fire in 1965, and it was closed in 1980. It is said that the clock above the entrance was brought from Switzerland, but this has never been proved. The building was restored by the town council in 2012, and the council also had the front wall painted by local students. Today visitors are welcomed every Sunday, and guided tours are offered.

The Old Station. The station was built in 1912 and was designed by the architect Mateo Vera. It was badly damaged by a fire in 1965, and it was closed in 1980. It is thought that the clock above the entrance was brought from Switzerland, but this has never been proved. The building was restored by the council in 2012. The council also had the front wall painted by some local students. Today the station is open to visitors every Sunday, and tours are offered.

feedback.es: Un texto de placa combina pasivas de hechos (was built, was damaged), el agente solo cuando informa (by Mateo Vera), atribución prudente (It is believed that) y un causativo (had the front wall painted).

origin.text: Datos: estación construida en 1912; diseñada por el arquitecto Mateo Vera; dañada por un incendio en 1965; cerrada en 1980 (no importa quién lo decidió); se cree que el reloj de la entrada fue traído de Suiza, pero nunca se ha probado; restaurada por el ayuntamiento en 2012, que también hizo pintar la fachada a estudiantes; hoy se abre a los visitantes los domingos y se ofrecen visitas guiadas.

prompt.es: Escucha la guía y elige qué se dice del reloj.

choices.text: It was made in this town.

feedback.es: La guía atribuye el origen («it is believed that») y aclara que nadie lo ha probado. La reparación de 2012 es del techo.

origin.audio: Welcome to the old station. It is believed that the clock above the gate was brought from Switzerland, but nobody has proved it. The roof was repaired in 2012.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase del borrador es la más prudente?

choices.text: It is believed that the tower was built by builders from France.
The tower was definitely built by builders from France.
Builders from France built the tower, and everybody knows it.

feedback.es: It is believed that… marca que el dato no está probado; las otras dos lo afirman con seguridad sin pruebas.

origin.text: Borrador para la placa de una torre: la autoría de los constructores franceses no está probada.

prompt.es: Completa: «El ayuntamiento hizo reparar el techo a una empresa local.»

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (had the roof repaired) y el agente con by.

origin.text: The council had the roof ___ by a local company.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La entrada fue pintada de azul.»

feedback.es: Pasiva simple en pasado: sujeto + was + participio + color.

choices.text: We had cleaned the windows by a local team.
We had the windows cleaned by a local team.
We made clean the windows by a local team.

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (had the windows cleaned); en las otras el orden o el verbo son incorrectos.

prompt.es: Reescribe con pasiva y atribución prudente.

It is thought that a famous painter lived here.
